title: introduce-adaptive-auth-delegation-and-stream-checkpoint-hooks
author: Maya Chen
description:
Context and motivation:
This PR adds two cross-sdk features that were requested by platform and integrator teams: 1) an adaptive delegated-auth mode (delegation to environment-specific token providers based on request hints) to reduce hot credential sprawl and simplify enterprise integrations, and 2) streaming checkpoint hooks that let consumers record stream progress (sequence/token offsets) so mission-critical consumers can resume gracefully without reprocessing large prefixes.

What changed (high level):
- New auth adapter: 'DelegatedAuthProvider' (python/ts/go) that accepts a chain of candidate token providers and a small selection policy (region, customer-tier, route metadata). The runtime will try the cheapest eligible provider first, falling back to higher-privilege providers when a request indicates an elevated SLO. This reduces token vending traffic and enables safer delegation for hosted/dedicated/private installs.
- Streaming progress API: consumers can now pass an optional 'checkpoint_hook' when opening a stream. Hooks are simple callables in each SDK that receive small progress markers (stream_id, offset, timestamp, optional metadata). Hooks are synchronous/async based on SDK idioms and intended to be lightweight (default noop).
- Unified retry profiles: hook points added so the SDK retry builder can nominate different retry profiles for delegated requests vs regular requests (lower retry floor for delegated providers that are expected to be ephemeral).
- Ergonomic surfaces: Python: contextmanager Stream.checkpointed(), TypeScript: startStreamingWithCheckpoint(opts), Go: StreamWithCheckpoint functional option. Each surface exposes the same minimal semantic: emit_checkpoint(marker) or await checkpoint acknowledgement from user hook.
- Tests and docs: added cross-lang examples and a new docs page (docs/sdk/checkpoints.md) describing recommended checkpoint semantics for idempotent vs at-most-once consumption patterns.
- Version bumps: python 0.11.0, typescript 1.27.0, go 1.8.0 (SDK minor/patch-lines adjusted accordingly).

Checklist:
- [x] Implementation in Python/TypeScript/Go
- [x] Unit tests for provider selection and checkpoint glue
- [x] Integration test: streaming resume scenario (flaky environment rerun)
- [x] Telemetry: added metrics for 'delegated_auth.provider.chosen' and 'stream.checkpoint.emitted'
- [x] Docs & changelogs updated

Related: Linear ENG-3001 (delegated auth), ENG-3002 (stream checkpoints), SUP-8123 (customer request to reduce token vending).

Notes and tradeoffs:
- DelegatedAuthProvider uses a conservative selection policy by default (prefer local short-lived tokens, then dedicated service tokens, then global long-lived tokens) to minimize blast radius. Customers can supply a custom selector.
- Checkpoint hooks are intentionally small; we avoided building a full checkpoint store to keep SDK surface minimal. Platform customers should use the hook to persist markers to a store that meets their durability SLOs.
- This PR does not change server-side routing or fallback policies; it only exposes client-side selection and telemetry. A follow-up will add server-side hints to improve provider scoring (ENG-3005).

feat(stream): add checkpoint hook interface across py/ts/go

docs: add checkpoints.md and examples for idempotent consumers
perf: micro-optimizations to stream envelope path to minimize checkpoint overhead

Priya Nair: Telemetry naming looks good; rename 'stream.checkpoint.emitted' -> 'stream.checkpoint.created' to match existing metric conventions. (updated in telemetry-metrics.yaml)
Liam O'Connor: Tests look solid but integration stream resume was flaky on the first CI run; added deterministic smoke harness and reduced timing jitter. CI re-run passed.

Diego Alvarez: Approved after small docs wording nitfixes.
release_notes: Add delegated auth provider chain (pluggable selection policy) and lightweight streaming checkpoint hooks across SDKs. Introduces telemetry for chosen auth providers and emitted checkpoints. Minor SDK version bumps: python 0.11.0, typescript 1.27.0, go 1.8.0.
